name: 46835 · Fort Wayne, IN
findings: ZIP 46835 (Fort Wayne) has 92 nonprofit organizations. 43 of them (47%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 30 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (39% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46835 (Fort Wayne) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 12 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
